summary: Started the Gizmo dev server in the background using the project's managed script `pnpm dev:server:start`, then verified it is running (PID 3904) with Vite ready at http://localhost:5173.
decisions: Used the managed `dev:server` script (start/stop/status/restart) instead of raw backgrounding, because package.json exposes it as the canonical way to run the dev server.
